يلتمسوا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَمِسُوا (yaltamisū) /jal.ta.mi.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# يُلْتَمَسُوا (yultamasū) /jul.ta.ma.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
